one_line: A messy before, an unfinished headline, a locked-off time-lapse, then a tidy reveal and a total price in the caption.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 blurred high-angle shot of children playing on a cluttered floor; 0:02 a static wide shot of the room. Voiceover (transcript): the safe room became a mess and she wanted a change. Text: "המהפך בממ״ד שלנו שמאיזור בלאגן הפך ל...".
q1_hook.why: A mess every parent of several children knows, and a headline that stops mid-sentence, open a gap the reveal closes at 0:34 (H5, K6), with voice and text from the first second (H4, H6). The first 2 s are a blurred, hard-to-read shot (against H1), and no product is shown yet (H2).

beats.what: Blurred children on a toy-filled floor; then the cluttered empty room; headline with "..."
beats.why: The before state and an unfinished sentence

beats.what: A flash transition; a woman unpacks a bag, puts up a tipi, shelves books, rolls out a blanket
beats.why: The first steps of the change, sped up

beats.what: Headline changes to "חדר קריאה ורוגע"; a cream rug, a lounge chair, a bag unpacked
beats.why: The text finishes the sentence, so the loop is answered

beats.what: She hangs framed prints; the room looks tidy
beats.why: The last step before the reveal

beats.what: Close-ups: lounge chair, tipi and shelf, a print reading "YOU ARE MY SUNSHINE", rug, two plush bunnies
beats.why: Six items in 6 s, each a fast new picture

beats.what: Wide shot of the finished corner from the doorway
beats.why: The payoff, set against the opening mess

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Voiceover at about 0:26-0:29 (transcript): she would love to know what viewers think. Caption: "אפשר לשאול הכל בתגובות".
q2_flow.why: The before at 0:00 and the reveal at 0:34 are a clean open loop and payoff (H5, R4, K2). Constant motion in the time-lapse keeps the middle moving (R3). Close-ups at 0:27-0:33 are fast, and the Reel ends 3 s after the reveal (R1, E8). A before and after a parent might send on (R5).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) about 0:26-0:29: she would be happy to know what viewers think. No text ask in the video. Caption, last line: "אפשר לשאול הכל בתגובות". No link or product name.
q3_cta.why: One soft invitation to comment, in voice and caption (C1), but it is an open invitation, not a specific question a parent can answer from their own life (against C5, R6). Nothing names a product or shop, so the only next step is a question in the comments.

q4_shown.what: The messy room with children 0:00-0:04; the makeover in one sped-up locked-off shot 0:05-0:26 (tipi, books, rug, chair, prints); six close-ups 0:27-0:33; the finished corner 0:34-0:36. A woman in profile or from behind; no brand names. Total price in the caption.
q4_shown.why: A before and after of the same room is the clearest proof the change is big (R4, K2). The books on the shelf are the point of the corner, though small in wide shots (F4). No item is named, so it is lifestyle, not a recommendation (C7). The caption gives the whole price (S3).

q5_edit.what: About 10 shots in 37 s: two 2 s opening shots, a flash transition at about 0:04, one locked-off sped-up shot of about 22 s, six 1 to 2 s close-ups, a 3 s wide pan. Two headlines, no subtitles. Ends on the finished room.
q5_edit.why: The time-lapse gives continuous motion and a clear process in one shot (E3, R3), and the close-ups speed up for the reveal (E2). With no subtitles of the voice, a muted viewer relies on two headlines (E4, T1). It ends on the payoff with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother turns a cluttered safe room into a reading corner for under a stated total price; it serves parents who want a calm space for reading.
q6_topic.why: A real concern, too many toys and too little calm, answered with a copyable idea (K6, K4), told by a mother with a professional credential (S6) and a total price that makes it feel doable. Reading is the theme, which fits LumeBook. Calm and tidy, with no high-arousal peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A handheld blurred opening at a high angle; a locked-off wide shot of a bright room, the phone propped at about chest height in warm light; handheld close-ups of items; a final handheld wide pan from the doorway. A woman in profile or from behind.
q7_filmed.why: A locked-off wide shot lets the viewer watch the whole room change, which a phone tripod does well (E6, F7). Close-ups of cushions and prints fill the frame and read at phone size (F4). Children appear only in the first 2 s, blurred (S5).

q8_text.on_screen: White outlined sans-serif, centred about 18 to 28 percent down, inside the safe zone: "המהפך בממ״ד שלנו שמאיזור בלאגן הפך ל..." (0:00-0:14), then "חדר קריאה ורוגע" with a white heart (0:15-0:26). No text over the close-ups or the reveal. No subtitles of the voiceover.
q8_text.caption: "כמה אקססוריז והשינוי כל כך משמעותי!!!". About 22 words in 3 short lines: the claim, "והכל בפחות מ-1200 ש״ח ❤️" and thanks, "אפשר לשאול הכל בתגובות😊". No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: A headline that ends in "..." and is finished by the second card makes the text part of the loop, and both sit clear of the bottom zone (T3, H5, T4). The caption puts the whole price in shekels up front but has no hashtags or room-type search words (S3, T7).

weak_points: A blurred first 2 s; no item named or linked; a 22 s voiceover with no subtitles; an open "tell me what you think"; a long voiceover over a time-lapse; no hashtags.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a before and after of a shelf with a locked-off phone, ending on a personalised book in place, with a headline that stops at "..." and finishes halfway through.
not_verified: That she is a speech therapist or an author (the transcript's "קליני תקשורת" is likely a mishearing). Music (the voiceover runs throughout; the "תודה רבה" at 30-37 s is not speech). Whether the voice is hers. The number of children (about five seen at 0:01). The reading corner's items and brands. Correction: the text card changes at about 0:15, not 0:14.5; she faces away or in profile throughout, so no clear face.
